queries_run: Cardinal Health CVS Health contract largest customer 2026
CVS Health Cardinal Health generic sourcing Red Oak OR in-house OR second source distribution 2026

findings.claim: 最大客戶 CVS Health 占 FY2026 營收 28%，前五大客戶合計 43%（集中度高）。
findings.excerpt: Our largest customer, CVS Health, accounted for 28 percent of our fiscal 2026 revenue. In the aggregate, our five largest customers, including CVS Health, accounted for 43 percent of our fiscal 2026 revenue.

findings.claim: 2026-10-01 Cardinal 與 CVS 簽具約束力意向書，將配銷協議延長至 2032-06-30，服務範圍不變；尚未定案。搜尋未見 CVS 導入第二供應商或自製配銷的報導。
findings.source: Distribution Strategy: Cardinal Health Extends CVS Pharmaceutical Distribution Deal Through 2032

customer_second_source.note: 無 second-source 或 in-house 證據；Red Oak 為 CVS 與 Cardinal 各 50% 的學名藥採購合資。
